PDRN is all over your feed right now, but how does it really stack up against retinoids? While PDRN shows early promise as a gentle, skin-supporting ingredient, the research behind it is still limited. Retinoids, on the other hand, have decades of clinical evidence for reducing fine lines, acne, and uneven texture. So if you want proven results, retinoids are still the gold standard.

To mix or not to mix? 🧪 Let’s look at the science 👀

Layering active ingredients can feel like a guessing game. While some pairings work to boost your results, combining the wrong actives or using too many at once can quickly compromise your skin barrier and cause irritation.

We’ve put together this clinical cheat sheet so you know exactly which ingredients to combine, which to split between your AM and PM routines, and which to avoid layering entirely.

💡 Expert tip: When in doubt, a “”less is more”” approach is always best. A few targeted, evidence-backed ingredients will always outperform a complicated 10-step routine.
